stemMd: The graph of y = |x| is reflected across the horizontal axis. Which equation describes the result?
explanationMd: Reflection across the horizontal axis keeps each x coordinate and negates its y coordinate. Thus every |x| value becomes −|x|. Negating the input instead would reflect horizontally and leave this particular graph unchanged.

distractorRationale.c: This is unchanged because absolute value is even.
distractorRationale.a: This shifts downward by one rather than reflecting.
distractorRationale.d: This takes a reciprocal, not a reflection.
